examples.english: I called my friend in the evening.

examples.arabic: في المساء امشي في السوق الجميل واشم رائحة القهوة
examples.english: In the evening I walk in the beautiful market and smell the coffee.
examples.transliteration: fi al-masa amshi fi as-suq al-jamil wa-ashummu raihat al-qahwa.

examples.arabic: قال طارق السلام عليكم مساء الخير
examples.english: Tariq said peace be upon you good evening
examples.transliteration: Qala Tariq as-salamu alaykum masa al-khayr

examples.arabic: راى خالد شرطيا وقال له مساء الخير كيف حالك
examples.english: Khalid saw a policeman and said to him good evening how are you.
examples.transliteration: raa khalid shurtiyan wa qala lahu masa al khayr kayfa haluka

examples.arabic: يذهب خالد الى السوق في المساء
examples.english: Khalid goes to the market in the evening.
examples.transliteration: Yadhhabu khalid ila as suq fi al masa
